#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BACKUPS_JSON="/home/user/backups.json"
SYNC_LOG="/home/user/sync.log"
REPORT="/home/user/dedup_report.csv"
SYMLINK="/home/user/latest_backup"

# Helper to trim leading/trailing whitespace.
trim() {
    local var="$1"
    var="${var#"${var%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    var="${var%"${var##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    printf '%s' "$var"
}

# Extract the base and incremental backup directories from the JSON file.
base_dir="$(awk -F'"' '/"base"/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="base") {print $(i+2); exit}}' "$BACKUPS_JSON")"
inc_dir="$(awk -F'"' '/"inc"/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="inc") {print $(i+2); exit}}' "$BACKUPS_JSON")"

if [[ -z "$base_dir" || -z "$inc_dir" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Could not parse backup directories from $BACKUPS_JSON" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Initialize the CSV report with the required header.
printf 'filename,saved_bytes\n' > "$REPORT"

# Parse the sync log and process every successfully backed-up file.
current_file=""
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    if [[ "$line" == FILE:* ]]; then
        current_file="$(trim "${line#FILE:}")"
    elif [[ "$line" == STATUS:* ]]; then
        status="$(trim "${line#STATUS:}")"
        if [[ "$status" == "SUCCESS" && -n "$current_file" ]]; then
            base_path="$base_dir/$current_file"
            inc_path="$inc_dir/$current_file"

            if [[ -f "$base_path" && -f "$inc_path" ]] && cmp -s "$base_path" "$inc_path"; then
                saved_bytes="$(stat -c %s "$base_path")"

                ln "$base_path" "$inc_path"
                printf '%s,%s\n' "$current_file" "$saved_bytes" >> "$REPORT"
            fi
        fi
        current_file=""
    fi
done < "$SYNC_LOG"

# Point the latest_backup symlink at the incremental backup directory.
rm -f "$SYMLINK"
ln -s "$inc_dir" "$SYMLINK"

echo "Deduplication complete. Report written to $REPORT"
EOF

            fi
        fi
